analyst_view.overall: Early view: Nice under Olivier Pantaloni have won four of their last five and Wahi has 6 league goals, while Lens are in turmoil after a 9-1 Champions League home defeat to Como, three straight defeats and the sacking of Yannick Cahuzac, their second coach change of the season. Lens host Bodo/Glimt in the Champions League on the Wednesday before this Saturday game, while Nice have no European football.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. Lens' defence has collapsed (12 goals conceded in their last three games in all competitions, with centre-back Ismaelo Ganiou injured), and they arrive on three days' rest. Nice score regularly at home, so I lean higher.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners. Nice should have more of the ball at home, but nothing points clearly away from the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards. A Lens side under a new coach may be more disciplined early on; nothing points either way yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.3 shots. A tired Lens side may create less, but Nice should take more shots; the two balance near the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target. With Lens' defence in poor shape and playing three days after a Champions League game, Nice should get clear sights of goal, so I lean slightly higher.
